_note: Live sponsors for the guide. js/sponsor.js reads this on every guide page that carries <div id="sponsor-footer">; js/app.js (things-to-do) reads it for the in-list cards too. While `sponsors` is empty or nothing is active, the footer slot shows the rotating house unit ('this spot could be yours') pointing at advertise.html. Add a real sponsor by copying data/sponsors.example.json's entry into `sponsors`. Never add a sponsor here before the first payment has cleared.

_schema.name: display name exactly as the sponsor writes it
_schema.url: https:// link readers land on (add ?utm_source=btownbrief&utm_medium=guide yourself if they want it)
_schema.image: optional; assets/sponsors/<id>.png or .svg, max height 48px in the footer; omit for a text link
_schema.tagline: optional, under 80 characters, shown after the name in the footer
_schema.placement: 'footer' (bottom of guide pages) or 'list' (a card every 12 entries on things-to-do)
_schema.pages: optional list of page filenames the footer unit is limited to, e.g. ['events.html','restaurants.html']; omit = every page
_schema.active: true to show; false keeps the row on file without rendering it
_schema.ends: YYYY-MM-DD last day it shows (optional); after this the row stops rendering by itself
_schema.category: the exclusive category as written in the agreement, e.g. 'dentist' (for the seller's own records; not rendered)
